paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Distribution of samples (%) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity.
model_annotation: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart showing the distribution of samples (percent) across two ambiguity-related variables, with the outer ring representing “Ambiguity Std” and the inner ring representing “Max Ambiguity.” The outer ring contains four slices with percentage labels: “Std: 0.0” in a dark teal-blue at approximately 49.0%, “Std: 0.47” in a medium teal-blue at about 39.0%, “Std: 0.82” in a brighter blue at about 5.0%, and “Std: 0.94” in a lighter cyan-blue at about 7.0%. The inner ring contains three slices with percentage labels: “Max: 1” in a medium light blue at about 47.7%, “Max: 2” in a lighter blue at about 38.0%, and “Max: 3” in a very pale blue at about 14.2%. Two separate legends appear on the right, titled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner),” mapping the colors to categories; no slices are exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segment placement appears arranged around the circle rather than strictly ordered by size.
